method.scope: All native PCB_VIA objects against all F/B SMD copper, independently from all footprint-owned PTH pads. Drills use nominal KiCad hole size; actual fabrication tolerance is not simulated.
method.mask_and_paste_note: Classification is drill vs actual SMD copper, not courtyard or solder mask opening. Annular-only contact does not mean drill-in-pad; very small residual drill/pad gap still needs mask-web and solder-wicking review.

manufacturing_notes: Do not infer VIP fill/cap manufacturing from via tenting flags.
All drill-in-SMD native vias and module footprint thermal PTH require explicit filled/planarized/capped manufacturing disposition or a reviewed layout change.
Normal connector/button PTH must stay open for component leads; do not blanket-fill every PTH drill.
Annular-only contacts are a separate review class; review nominal drill-to-pad gap, solder-mask web and actual tolerance.
